coverage_assessment: First open-web pass: 21 captured search invocations (batched queries) covered English/French month and year terms, weekly windows, major cities/regions, political and opposition mobilization, students and teachers, public/private labor, transport, rights, price and land themes, and December/February boundaries. Thirteen source cards retain opened, announced, search-only and undated leads. No January public gathering meeting the MM protest threshold was verified. The opened Actu Cameroun report says the scheduled 8 January SDF march in Douala did not occur after prohibitions; a separate Peace Week announcement remains unverified. Six narrowly scoped exclusions distinguish plans/nonoccurrence, advocacy reporting, a sports-crowd disaster, a football-support mobilization, and a reported funeral. No absence or exhaustiveness claim is made. Web searches do not replace LexisNexis, local print/radio archives or local-language coverage; official baseline/procedure and all coding remain pending review.
